newsitem.title: USA: First of America Bank buys insurance units.
newsitem.headline: First of America Bank buys insurance units.

text.p: First of America Bank Corp, a $22 billion asset bank holding company, said Friday it has purchased the insurance agencies of Elliott & Sons and Michigan Benefit Plans Inc located in Auburn Hills, Michigan.
First of America has acquired five insurance agencies in Michigan and Illinois over the past two years and said it will continue to expand these lines of business.

Elliott & Sons and Michigan Benefit Plans distribute auto and homeowner insurance products, personal and commercial lines of group insurance, employee benefit and other financial services. The company has 28 employees.

First of America has $15 billion in loans and $18 billion in deposits in Michigan, Illinois, Indiana and Florida. The company offers commercial and retail banking as well as mortgage origination services in North Carolina and Arizona.
